1.mascotDialogue: Nothin' fancy here — just compare your neighbor, swap if you're bigger, and repeat the whole sweep till nothin' needs swappin' no more.

2.mascotDialogue: That `n minus i minus 1` on line 3 shrinks the inner loop's range every pass — the last i elements are already sorted, ain't no need to keep checkin' 'em.

3.mascotDialogue: Watch that tallest bar creep one step right every swap it loses — that's the 'bubblin'' this whole thing's named after, made plain literal.

4.mascotDialogue: This one won't crash every time — that's the sneaky part. It'll just now and again read garbage past the array, and that's exactly the kind of bug that slips by, 'cause it don't always announce itself.
